title: Chat-server handler edge cases from batch 5
description: From batch-5 verify. (a) chat.rs ~L1012: Chat/set destroy prefetch uses map_err(server_fail)? so a backend error becomes method-level serverFail after creates/updates already committed; should be per-id notDestroyed. (b) Chat/set create stores avatarBlobId on a direct Chat; spec L1018 lists it only for group create (name/description likewise?). (c) message.rs store_server_message passes msg.id to create_object instead of the documented 'placeholder' sentinel (backend.rs ~L531). (d) space.rs L1098: Space create copies a listed extension key into extra even when it is a core Space property, contrary to backend.rs doc. (e) dfo4 added duplicate get_objects reads on Chat/set and Message/set update paths; reuse the first fetch.
close_reason: Landed in 3416e557 fix(chat-server)!: batch-5 set handler edge cases (batch 6, adversarially verified, CI green at a586c251)
